These Worlds Are Made of Light.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I choose a face from all the forms
A fox, a moon, a stitched-up storm
I move my hands; the room replies
A different shape, a different size

[Pre-Chorus]
Each small gesture leaves a trace
A doorway opening into space
I learn the world by learning me
Through what I try, through what I see

[Chorus]
These worlds are made of light
And I can choose how I arrive
A body borrowed, a self made wide
New paths unfolding as I try
These worlds are made of light

[Verse 2]
A softer voice, a braver stance
A thousand ways to risk a dance
The mind makes room where none had been
For selves we carry deep within

[Pre-Chorus]
Each meeting redraws the map
A thought can cross an old-life gap
I practice being, not pretending
A self in motion, never ending

[Chorus]
These worlds are made of light
And I can choose how I arrive
A body borrowed, a self made wide
New paths unfolding as I try
These worlds are made of light

[Bridge]
Not an escape from what is real
But one more way to learn and feel
I choose the shape; the choice is mine
A living thought made briefly shine

[Final Chorus]
These worlds are made of light
And I can choose how I arrive
A body borrowed, a self made wide
New paths unfolding as I try
These worlds are made of light

[Outro]
I choose, I enter, I become
And bring those pathways home

Erasing the Distance.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Soft synth pulses, glowing ambient pads)

[Verse 1]
We meet in the code where the shadows fade
A million pixels, a world we made
There is no gravity, no weight of clay
Just coordinates where our pulses play
Through the lens, the coordinates align
Your avatar's fingers brushing mine

[Chorus]
This world is made of light, glowing and bright
We are erasing the distance tonight
No miles between us, no borders in sight
Just you and me dancing in virtual light
In the neon glow, we are holding on tight
Erasing the distance, erasing the night

[Verse 2]
I touch your hand but it's haptic sparks
A digital current through the quiet dark
We build our castles in a server sky
Watching the artificial moons drift by
What is real when the feeling is true?
I've crossed the fiber optics just to get to you

[Chorus]
This world is made of light, glowing and bright
We are erasing the distance tonight
No miles between us, no borders in sight
Just you and me dancing in virtual light
In the neon glow, we are holding on tight
Erasing the distance, erasing the night

[Outro]
Just light...
No distance left...
(Soft glitch outro, fading synths)

This Small Forever.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You send the invite while the kettle starts to murmur
I find my headset, ask if you can hear me clear
A loading screen, then suddenly your little figure
Turns from the window like you knew that I was here
We meet inside a room someone designed with patience
A blue-painted door, a lamp, a low and lopsided chair
You show me where the shoreline bends behind the cabin
I tell you what the day has left behind me there

[Verse 2]
We learn the room by use, not by its floor plan
Your usual seat, the window where you stand
The tiny wave you give before you tell me
What you were trying not to say all afternoon
I tell you about the call I kept postponing
The burnt toast, the blue mug, the tiredness I hid
You listen without fixing every sentence
And let me finish what I nearly left unsaid

[Pre-Chorus]
We choose the private instance, close the doorway
Not to vanish, just to hear each other whole

[Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Let the hours loosen their grip
While we stay here, held together
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever

[Verse 3]
We wander through a garden made of paper lanterns
Then take a little train that circles nowhere fast
You point out stars someone arranged above the ceiling
I tell you which small details make the moment last
Your avatar sits beside me by the water
The gestures cannot give the warmth of skin
But when you turn your face to hear me better
I feel the welcome in the way you lean in

[Verse 4]
There’s more to this than hiding from the morning
We know the door is ours to open when we choose
The boundary is a kindness, not a fortress
A little room to set the noise down, not to lose
You ask me what I mean when I say lonely
I try again, and this time let it show
Your quiet gives the thought a place to settle
And I can trust you with the parts I didn’t know

[Pre-Chorus]
We know the walls are pixels, made to disappear
The care we bring is what makes staying real

[Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Let the hours loosen their grip
While we stay here, held together
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever

[Bridge]
If the picture freezes, if the server sends us home
If the cabin folds to menus and a blank display
I’ll remember how you waited through my pauses
How you made room for the words I couldn’t say
This isn’t saying life beyond us doesn’t matter
Or that a screen can hold a whole life by itself
It’s choosing, with permission, to be present
And giving all our attention somewhere safe to rest

[Final Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Let the hours loosen their grip
While we stay here, held together
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
And when we leave, we leave together
Carrying the quiet wherever

[Outro]
The lamp stays on inside the little cabin
You say goodnight; the window turns to gray
I lift the headset, find my own familiar room
And keep the tenderness we made that day

Sincerely.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We found each other past the loading screen,
Where a borrowed room became a place to stay.
You showed me how the windows faced the sea,
I learned the little things you’d never say.
We built a table no one else could see,
Set down our hurried days and let them rest.
Your avatar would turn to look at me,
And somehow that small gesture said the best.

[Pre-Chorus]
No door to knock on, no train to catch,
Just two quiet minds choosing the same map.
When all the ordinary hours had gone,
You were still there, and I could still belong.

[Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Even when the names we gave us change,
I’ll keep the good we made together.
Let the whole world wait outside,
Let the quiet hold us gently;
I will cherish what your love has been,
And meet you here as friends, sincerely.

[Verse 2]
We learned the shape of evenings by their rooms:
The lantern garden, rain against the glass,
The little world that held our changing moods,
The way an hour could feel too brief to pass.
We spoke of fears we’d carried all our lives,
Of family, work, the selves we couldn’t show.
You listened without asking me to hide;
I hope you felt that shelter in me too.

[Pre-Chorus]
Then love took on a different kind of name,
No less sincere because the shape had changed.
We let the old promises loosen, not erase,
And kept the tenderness, and gave it space.

[Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Even when the names we gave us change,
I’ll keep the good we made together.
Let the whole world wait outside,
Let the quiet hold us gently;
I will cherish what your love has been,
And meet you here as friends, sincerely.

[Bridge]
Inside this pocket universe,
I feel your kindness find me again.
A thousand little signs answered,
A steady thread that doesn’t need an end.
We don’t have to call it what it was;
We don’t have to turn away.
There’s room for all the ways we’ve loved,
And room for us to stay.

[Final Chorus]
Let the whole world wait outside
While we choose this small forever
Not as lovers holding tight to time,
But as two friends who know each other.
Let the whole world wait outside,
Let the quiet hold us gently;
I will cherish your love all my life,
And I’m grateful you’re still here with me.

[Outro]
When we close the door, the world can wait.
Somewhere in this room, we’ll meet again.
I’ll carry what you gave me, tenderly—
Your love, now friendship, still a place to land.
